title: The Role of a Lumberjack
author: Sensu OrangeVillager32
pages: The humble lumberjack is key for the maintenance of any village. They collect wood and convert it into charcoal for the village.
Every morning, a lumberjack goes to their sawmill and looks for trees to cut down. After they cut down a tree, they replant the sapling and turn some of the wood into charcoal.
Then, they sell their contents to the bank.
This role is vital to provide fuel for the bank and wood to repair doors broken by zombies.
